update.title: Built an evidence pipeline from Work Reports to portfolio pages
update.summary: Preserved screenshots, code, terminal output, comparisons, and data as typed Work Report artifacts, then mapped them into editable blocks for portfolio pages.
update.previewAlt: Diagram showing typed Work Report artifacts mapped to editable Portfolio Editor blocks and rendered on a portfolio page

blocks.body:
## Capture evidence as typed artifacts

Work Report now attaches screenshots, code samples, terminal output, comparisons, and structured data as typed artifacts. Each record identifies the kind of evidence and carries the content needed to use it again.

That turns material produced during daily work into structured input for documentation and portfolio authoring.

## Keep the material with the report

Files are copied into report-owned storage when they are captured, so the report does not depend on the original path remaining available. Text-based artifacts keep both a durable file and inline content: the editor can prefill an editable block while the site can render the same material from a file.

The report therefore preserves both the evidence and enough structure to reuse it.

blocks.caption: Artifact type selects the initial block while the editor keeps its content and placement editable.

  Artifact[Typed artifact] --> Kind{Artifact type}
  Kind -->|Screenshot| Image[Image block]
  Kind -->|Code| Code[Code block]

  Kind -->|Comparison| Compare[Comparison block]
  Kind -->|Data| Graph[Graph block]
  Image & Code & Terminal & Compare & Graph --> Page[Editable project page]

blocks.body:
## Turn artifact types into editable blocks

Portfolio Editor displays the artifacts attached to a report and maps each type to a matching content block. Dropping a code sample creates a code block; terminal output, comparisons, screenshots, and data receive their corresponding presentation.

The generated block is a starting point that can be moved, labeled, trimmed, or edited alongside the rest of the page.

## Render the same evidence on the portfolio page

Portfolio Site adds renderers for code, terminal sessions, comparisons, and graphs, along with file handling that carries attached material into the project’s media. Once the editor places and adjusts an artifact, the resulting block renders with the same type-specific presentation on the detail page.

Daily work can now move from report evidence to finished portfolio content without being rebuilt by hand.

part_of.title: Built Work Report System to preserve completed work
part_of.summary: Created a command-line reporting tool that records what changed, why it changed, project context, commit statistics, and file or image references as searchable PostgreSQL records.

parts.title: Added artifact staging and curation to Work Reports
parts.summary: Work Report now gathers captured evidence into a staging pool where it can be scored, captioned, approved, or rejected before the approved set is copied into report-owned storage.

parts.title: Connected visual tools to automatic artifact tracking
parts.summary: Diagram Tool and Screenshot Tool now publish saved visuals into artifact tracking through optional post-save adapters, making them discoverable by Work Report while keeping the tools independently runnable.

parts.title: Made Work Report artifacts durable at capture time
parts.summary: Copied attached files and reconstructed text artifacts into report-owned storage at capture time, so each Work Report retained the material it referenced.

parts.title: Fixed artifact rendering across the portfolio pipeline
parts.summary: Aligned Work Report previews, Portfolio Editor path handling, saved media, detail-page blocks, and browser revalidation so artifacts stay usable from capture through the rendered page.

related.title: Built Portfolio Editor to connect Work Reports to portfolio pages
related.summary: Portfolio Editor now combines Work Report material, structured project fields, seven composable block types, and the Portfolio Site renderer in one split-pane authoring workflow.

related.title: Built a timeline-based portfolio site
related.summary: Built a framework-free portfolio that loads project metadata from one JSON file, highlights featured work, and expands timeline entries as they move through the viewport.
